a.item: THE HYDROGEN AUDIT — does hydrogen's structural skeleton sit fully inside forced ∪ free-with-prior ∪ typed-outside?
a.headline: Yes, with nothing orphaned: the gauge-quantum-number skeleton of hydrogen (U(1) direction, e/3 charge quantization with the exact 1:3 lepton:quark ratio, electron/quark/proton color-and-charge content, photon adjoint) is FORCED and re-verified in-sandbox this session; two items are FREE-WITH-PRIOR torsors with the object's own counting-measure prior (the chirality/antimatter sign; the Wilson-menu row); everything spin-, EWSB-, generation- and value/dynamics-shaped is OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN, per Gate 5 and the corpus's own functor gap (WORKING_RULES rule 6) — this is a Tier-1 mathematical reproduction of GUT structure, not a physics derivation.

claims.statement: [ITEM 1a, TYPE: FORCED] The hypercharge U(1) generator — the unique gaugeable abelian direction in the chain's abelian sector — exists at the cascade's terminal registerable algebra su(3)⊕su(2)⊕u(1)_Y, and a U(1) factor survives every row of the object's own order-5 Wilson menu (no row of the menu ever eliminates every abelian factor).
claims.evidence: B864 (opened): Q=aY+bχ+cψ over the chiral generation gives grav=5b+15c, [SU(3)]²=2c, [SU(2)]²=2c, forcing b=c=0 exactly — Y is the unique gaugeable direction, exact arithmetic. B892 (opened): z(x1,y*)=su(3)⊕su(2)⊕u(1)^3 exactly (dim 14, derived 11, centre 3). B992 (opened): span(Y,χ,ψ) = that u(1)^3 exactly (the naive full-centralizer count of 9 first failed; the Cartan-restricted count gives exactly 3). B862 (opened): the cascade selects the global form [SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)]/Z6, kernel computed exactly (diag(2,2,2,-3,-3)/6). B863 (opened): the SM is the terminal registerable algebra — every proper descent (su(2)->u(1); su(3)->su(2)xu(1) regular; the genuine conformal su(3)_1->su(2)_4 embedding; full abelianization) kills chirality; the SM alone (positive control) passes. B1079 (opened, dated 2026-08-19): all 5^6-1=15,624 order-5 coweight points enumerated twice; every one of the 9 rows carries u(1)'s because E6's Kac marks (1,2,2,3,2,1) are all <=3 (Kac's theorem). Non-vacuous: order-2 and order-3 elements DO reach two center-0 rows (su(6)+su(2) at 36/63; su(3)^3 at 80/728).

claims.statement: [ITEM 1b, TYPE: OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN] Identifying this forced u(1)_Y specifically with U(1)_em (rather than pre-EWSB u(1)_Y) requires the further step SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y -> U(1)_em via a Higgs-doublet vacuum expectation value. This is standard electroweak-symmetry-breaking machinery, never derived or attempted by this program.
claims.evidence: docs/SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER.md SS A3 lists the Higgs doublet + EWSB inside the target specification, not in SS C's 'what this object has delivered' table (no EWSB/Higgs-mechanism row exists there). B862 FINDINGS' own layer ledger (opened) lists 'layer 7 (Higgs rep) ... remain[s] open' among nine SM-architecture layers. Gate 5 (docs/THE_END_TO_END_CHAIN.md PART VII, opened): 'The object supplies no scale, no time, no dynamics' — a Higgs-potential/VEV-selection dynamics is exactly the missing ingredient, of the same universal-not-peculiar kind already documented for the rank-reducing 27 VEV (docs/THE_SM_VERDICT.md SS3: 'the object's shortfall is not unusual ... arriving at the same place every GUT arrives').

claims.statement: [ITEM 2, TYPE: FORCED] The 27's u(1) charges under the SM-shaped landing (E6 superset SO(10)xU(1)_psi superset SU(5)xU(1)_chi superset SM, one normalization fixed per step) come out automatically quantized in exact multiples of e/3: quark charges land on {+/-1/3,+/-2/3}, lepton charges land on integers {0,+/-1} — the 1:3 lepton:quark minimal-unit ratio is exact and automatic, not fitted.
claims.evidence: B970 WORK.md SS1 (opened): psi,chi,Y are the unique Cartan elements commuting with so(10)/su(5)/su(3)+su(2) respectively, each unique up to one normalization; fixing psi(16)=1, chi(5bar in 16)=3, Y(Q)=1/6, EVERY other hypercharge is PREDICTED not fitted (10 predictions, tracelessness checked exactly: Sum Q_em over the 27 = 0). Cross-verified two independent routes: B884's numeric 30-digit piece_dims matches B970's exact-rational Cartan-matrix route bit for bit. RE-DERIVED IN-SANDBOX this session ((scratchpad) fractions.Fraction, exact rational): re-entered the (SU(3),T3,Y) table, computed Q_em=T3+Y for all six SM-shaped fields; CHECK A confirmed every charge is an exact multiple of e/3; CHECK B confirmed every lepton charge is an exact integer multiple of e; CHECK C confirmed every quark-charge denominator is exactly 3. Non-vacuity witness: B970 SS2 ran the identical membership test on the 78 (adjoint) and it FAILED (Y=-5/6 for the X/Y leptoquark bosons, a charge belonging to no field of the 16), proving the check bites.

claims.statement: [ITEM 2 addendum, TYPE: FORCED, corollary of item 2] Neutral hydrogen's charge cancellation is not an extra assumption: the proton's charge (uud = 2*Q(u)+Q(d) = 2*(2/3)+(-1/3) = +1, exact) cancels the electron's charge (Q(e)=-1, exact) EXACTLY, forced by the same weight-lattice quantization that gives item 2.

claims.evidence: B970 WORK.md SS1.2/SS1.4 (opened): 'Y(Q)=1/6 | u^c=-2/3, d^c=1/3, L=-1/2, e^c=1, nu^c=0'; the piece table SS3.2 lists 'nu^c, e^c, S three (1,1) 3' among the 11 Levi pieces, all SU(3) singlets. Re-verified in-sandbox (hydrogen_checks.py). CAVEAT threading to item 6: this establishes gauge quantum numbers only. That these weights are populated by spin-1/2 fermions rather than scalars is a standard-GUT modeling convention (SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER SSA2: 'one generation, all as left-handed Weyl fermions'), imported not derived — direct in-repo evidence: the SAME 27 uses two OTHER weights with IDENTICAL gauge numbers to L/L-conjugate (H_d, H_u) as SCALAR Higgs doublets in the standard reading (THE_END_TO_END_CHAIN.md PART VIII: 'two Higgs doublets'), proving gauge quantum number alone never fixes spin-statistics.

claims.statement: [ITEM 5, TYPE: FORCED, trivially, GIVEN color=SU(3) which is itself forced per item 1] The tensor cube of SU(3)'s fundamental 3(x)3(x)3 contains the trivial representation (the color singlet a three-quark baryon needs) with multiplicity EXACTLY ONE, via the totally antisymmetric epsilon_ijk contraction. Non-vacuous: it fails for SU(2) and for SU(4)/SU(5) with three copies, so N=3 (forced for color) is load-bearing.
claims.evidence: Computed in-sandbox this session (scratchpad/su3_singlet_check.py): Schur-Weyl duality via the hook-content formula for GL(3), partitions of 3 with <=3 rows: (3)->dim 10, (2,1)->dim 8 x S3-mult 2, (1,1,1)->dim 1 x S3-mult 1 (= Lambda^3(fundamental) = det = SU(3)-trivial). Total dimension check 10*1+8*2+1*1=27=3^3 passes; singlet multiplicity computed = exactly 1. Fail-witnesses also computed: SU(2)'s 2(x)2(x)2 = 2+2+4 (dims 2+2+4=8) has NO singlet at all (partition (1,1,1) needs 3 rows > N=2, impossible); SU(4)'s Lambda^3(4) is a 4 (not trivial) and SU(5)'s Lambda^3(5) is a 10 (not trivial). Upstream: SU(3)_C is forced as a summand of the terminal algebra (B892/B863, item 1's citations).

That this antisymmetric combination is the one physically realized (rather than e.g. a symmetric one) additionally requires the quarks to be identical fermions obeying spin-statistics (Pauli antisymmetrization of the full wavefunction) — item 6's finding, not separately re-derived here.

Same for su(3)'s eight gluons and su(2)'s three weak bosons.

Graded PROPOSED-NOT-BANKED because this specific application (electron-vs-positron) of the brand-new (2026-08-19) SS3 theorem is this session's synthesis, not a pre-existing banked sentence, though both ingredients (B713's torsor, SS3's prior-fixing theorem) are independently banked/proved.

claims.statement: [VERDICT ROW] The skeleton decomposes cleanly into the three types with nothing orphaned. FORCED: the u(1)_Y direction+algebra, the Z6 global form, exact e/3 charge quantization with its 1:3 ratio (and hydrogen's exact neutrality as a direct corollary), the color-singlet/charge content of electron+quarks+proton (3(x)3(x)3 contains 1 exactly once), the photon's adjoint content, and the mere EXISTENCE of a 27-vs-27bar antimatter partner. FREE-WITH-PRIOR (torsor AND prior both cited, per THE_FORCED_AND_THE_FREE.md SS3): the chirality/matter-vs-antimatter sign (B713, prior = counting measure on 2 elements) and the specific Wilson-menu row hydrogen's world instantiates (B1079, prior = counting measure on 15,624 elements, weights = the row multiplicities). OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN (typed via Gate 5 / KIND_TABLE.md): the EWSB step from u(1)_Y to U(1)_em, physical spin-1/2 and spin-statistics, generation selection (now doubly open post-B1033), and every value/dynamics item (m_e, m_p, alpha, the Coulomb law, any Hamiltonian). ONE ITEM STRETCHES THE TRICHOTOMY, named rather than hidden: 'is a given weight a fermion or a scalar' has no enumerated menu-with-computed-prior anywhere in the corpus the way the chirality and row torsors do -- it is closer to a silent PRESUPPOSITION of the whole GUT-reproduction exercise than a torsor, so it is filed OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN (dynamics-adjacent, same missing Lorentzian/Hamiltonian apparatus as item 10) rather than forced into FREE-WITH-PRIOR's shape. No ingredient was found that is neither forced, free-with-prior, nor typed-outside.

(2) B1079's Wilson-menu enumeration found order-2 and order-3 elements DO reach two center-0 (u(1)-free) rows (su(6)+su(2) at multiplicity 36/63; su(3)^3 at 80/728) -- proving 'a u(1) survives' is a real, order-5-specific, bitten constraint (Kac's marks argument), not true for every order. (3) Computed in-sandbox this session: SU(2)'s 2(x)2(x)2 = 2+2+4 contains NO trivial representation at all (the partition (1,1,1) needs 3 rows, impossible for N=2) -- proving the 3-quark color-singlet construction genuinely depends on color being SU(3) specifically, not automatic for an arbitrary gauge group. (4) Computed in-sandbox: SU(4)'s and SU(5)'s Lambda^3(fundamental) are 4-dimensional and 10-dimensional respectively (not the 1-dimensional trivial rep) -- three copies is the wrong number for those groups; only N=3 turns 3 copies of the fundamental into a singlet, reinforcing (3). (5) B863's registerability test has four failing configurations named IN ADVANCE and computed to fail (su(2)->u(1); su(3)->su(2)xu(1) regular; the genuine conformal su(3)_1->su(2)_4 embedding; full abelianization -- all vector-like, chirality dies) against one passing positive control (the SM itself) -- the termination theorem is falsifiable and was tested against real failures, not asserted. (6) B713's own Probe 1 (the multiplicity/triality route to chirality) was tried FIRST and FAILED (shown to be gauge-only, not acting on the object) before Probe 2 established the Galois-torsor route that stands -- an honest failed alternate route on the record, not cherry-picked. (7) B945 tested and WITHDREW a proposed unification of the chirality torsor with the time-reversal closing (OUTCOME INDEPENDENT, full Klein-group stabilizer found) -- a genuine negative that keeps item 8's chirality torsor analytically separate from item 6/10's time/dynamics absence rather than letting this audit conflate them. (8) B991 computed symbolically (not merely cited) that every one of the four anomaly-cancellation conditions scales homogeneously under q -> lambda*q -- a positive, checkable derivation of the item-10b impossibility, not an assumed one.
a.notes: Scope: this audits protium (^1H, one proton + one electron, no neutron). Deuterium/tritium would additionally need the neutron (udd, the same weight-lattice content as the proton with u<->d roles swapped) -- not separately audited here, no new group theory is implicated. The same 16 that supplies the electron and quarks also contains nu and nu^c (Y=0, color singlet, T3=+1/2 partner of the electron in L) -- present in the skeleton but not a constituent of hydrogen itself, mentioned only for completeness of 'the 16'. v.item: THE HYDROGEN AUDIT — adversarial review per LENS (i) recompute the two decisive weight-lattice claims from an independent 27 decomposition; (ii) attack completeness; (iii) attack every FORCED citation; (iv) attack the OUTSIDE typings against the kind table
v.finding:
VERDICT: the audit survives. Its trichotomy (FORCED / FREE-WITH-PRIOR / OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN, nothing orphaned) holds after an independent from-scratch recomputation and a full citation-fidelity pass. Several real, non-fatal defects were found and are listed below — they should be fixed, but none flips a TYPE grade.

(i) INDEPENDENT RECOMPUTATION — the decisive claims, rebuilt from scratch, not copied.
First finding, before the math: the original audit's own "RE-DERIVED IN-SANDBOX" scripts (scratchpad/hydrogen_checks.py, hydrogen_checks2.py) only re-typed B970's already-published charge table by hand and checked downstream arithmetic identities (multiples of e/3, integer leptons, proton+electron=0). That is real but shallow — it is not a rebuild from the E6 root system, so the audit's "RE-DERIVED" language oversells what was actually done. su3_singlet_check.py is the exception: a genuine independent Schur–Weyl/hook-length computation, correctly executed.

I therefore did the real rebuild myself, independent of B970's exotics_levi.py (never read): built E6's Cartan matrix from the Bourbaki diagram (own code), generated the 27 as the Weyl orbit of ω₁ by BFS on simple reflections of Dynkin-label vectors (own code, confirmed minuscule: 27 weights, every label in {-1,0,1}), then derived ψ, χ, Y as the fundamental coweight directions dual to the deleted nodes at each step of E6⊃SO(10)×U(1)_ψ⊃SU(5)×U(1)_χ⊃SM×U(1)_Y. First attempt used the full 6×6 inverse Cartan matrix for every charge and got the chi-split WRONG (asymmetric, {-1,0} instead of {+2,-2} for the "10"); diagnosed the bug (chi must live purely inside so(10)'s own Cartan, requiring so(10)'s own 5×5 sub-Cartan-matrix, not the ambient 6×6) and fixed it. The corrected, fully independent computation reproduces B970's entire table exactly: psi sectors {-2:10, +1:16, +4:1}; chi within the 16 = {-5:1, -1:10, +3:5}; chi within the 10 = {-2:5, +2:5}; and, after normalizing Y(Q)=1/6, every one of the 27 states' (SU3,T3,Y,Q_em) matches B970's Table 1.4 group-by-group (D,H_u,D̄,H_d,S,Q,u^c,e^c,d^c,L,ν^c) with no discrepancy. Independently confirmed: every Q_em is an exact multiple of e/3 (7 distinct values found: -1,-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3,1); every color-singlet charge is an integer; every colored charge has denominator exactly 3; Q(proton)=2Q(u)+Q(d)=1 and Q(proton)+Q(electron)=0 exactly; ΣY=ΣQ_em=0 over the 27. This also matches standard Georgi–Glashow SU(5)/SO(10) GUT charge assignments, independently known from the physics literature, outside this repo. Scripts: (scratchpad) _v5_summary.py, _v6_finalchecks.py. This is the strongest evidence in the audit's favor: the two decisive claims survive a genuine, independently-coded, bug-caught-and-fixed rebuild.

(ii) COMPLETENESS ATTACK.
Two real ingredients of an actual hydrogen atom are never named anywhere in the audit's inventory (not even folded into an OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN bucket by name, unlike EWSB/spin/generation-count which each get their own item): (a) baryon-number conservation / proton stability — E6/SO(10)-type unification is famous in the literature for generically threatening proton decay via extra gauge bosons and the exotic vector-like states this same 27 carries (D, D̄ etc.), and the audit is silent on whether anything in the object's structure bears on this; (b) QCD confinement / asymptotic freedom — item 5 shows a color singlet exists in 3⊗3⊗3 with multiplicity one, but that a genuine bound proton exists as the only asymptotic state (rather than free quarks) is a separate, highly nontrivial dynamical fact (confinement), not addressed even as a caveat the way item 5's spin-statistics caveat is. Both gaps would almost certainly type OUTSIDE-THE-CHAIN if raised (squarely inside Gate 5's "no dynamics" firewall and KIND_TABLE's RG taxonomy), so they likely would not change the trichotomy's bottom line — but the "nothing orphaned" claim is not quite earned as stated, since these two items were never enumerated to be typed at all. Minor: the audit's own scope note ("deuterium/tritium... no new group theory is implicated") is asserted, not computed; I verified it trivially myself (Q(neutron)=2Q(d)+Q(u)=2(-1/3)+2/3=0 from the same table), so the claim is true but was unearned in the original text.

(iii) ATTACK ON FORCED CITATIONS — all 16 cited arcs (B864, B892, B863, B862, B970, B978, B992, B991, B951, B1079, B1077, B713, B945, B280, B963, B1033) were opened directly (not grepped-and-trusted) and each genuinely supports the specific sentence it is cited for; quoted text was checked near-verbatim against source in every case I sampled (all matched). Two moderate defects found in how citations are woven together, both in item 1a: (1) item 1a's phrase "exists at the cascade's terminal registerable algebra su(3)⊕su(2)⊕u(1)_Y" risks exactly the overstatement B892's own FINDINGS.md flags in a prominent correction banner at the top of that same file (cited by item 1a as evidence!): the actually-computed terminal algebra is 14-dimensional with a full u(1)³, not the 12-dimensional su(3)⊕su(2)⊕u(1)_Y the phrasing suggests — B892's banner says explicitly "the chain is two steps from the SM, not zero." The underlying FORCED fact (Y is the unique gaugeable direction, given the chiral matter) is solid via B864/B992; the wording conflates it with rank-reduction, which is not achieved. (2) Item 1a also invokes B1079's Wilson-menu "a U(1) survives every row" as reinforcing evidence, but B1079 itself states the cascade's own A₂+A₁ landing point is "ABSENT at orders 5, 2, AND 3" from that menu — the Wilson menu and the cascade's terminal algebra appear to be different constructions (VEV-direction selection vs. the cascade's own descent), so stringing them into one sentence as mutually-reinforcing may conflate two different questions; the core claim does not need this citation and stands without it. Separately, and only tangentially touching this audit: docs/THE_FORCED_AND_THE_FREE.md — the very doc the house guard designates for defining FREE-WITH-PRIOR — carries a stale rider in §4 ("the two charge closings COMPETE," cited to B963) that B963's own amendment banner (B1017, nine days earlier) explicitly retracts as "a category slip." The hydrogen audit only draws on that doc's §3 (the counting-measure theorem), which is untouched by the retraction, so this doesn't poison the audit's own claims, but it is a live currency bug in load-bearing infrastructure worth flagging.

(iv) OUTSIDE-TYPINGS AGAINST THE KIND TABLE.
This attack largely fails to find a hole. Only items 10a/10b actually need KIND_TABLE.md (value-comparison-kind questions), and both quotes check out verbatim against docs/KIND_TABLE.md (the m_p/m_e "CLOSED... frame-relative (B936)" line and the gauge-ratio "STRONG" line, both exact). Items typed OUTSIDE without a KIND_TABLE citation (EWSB, spin-statistics, dynamics generally, generation count) are correctly typed via Gate 5 / SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER instead, and checking KIND_TABLE.md's own text shows this is the right call, not a shortcut: KIND_TABLE.md explicitly disclaims jurisdiction over generation count itself ("generation count, ℤ₆ | integer/structure | already Tier-1 territory, not crossing targets"), so forcing that citation onto item 11 would have been wrong, and the audit correctly didn't. Gate 5's "no scale, no time, no dynamics" and GOVERNANCE.md §2's framing lock were both verified verbatim in docs/THE_END_TO_END_CHAIN.md and GOVERNANCE.md. One corpus-wide (not audit-specific) tension is worth naming: GOVERNANCE §2 says the object's contents never include "a gauge group," which sits uneasily against the SM-structure campaign's FORCED claims of deriving one — but the audit's own META-CAVEAT ("Tier 1... reproduced not predicted... not a claim that this object's internal structure literally IS or generates physical hydrogen") substantially pre-empts this concern, even without naming GOVERNANCE §2 directly.
